summary_1line: Vyasa grants Sanjaya divine sight to narrate the war to Dhritarashtra and describes terrifying cosmic and earthly omens foretelling massive slaughter.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Vyasa stands before the blind king Dhritarashtra and blesses Sanjaya with celestial sight to witness the distant battlefield.
Dark skies swirl with red and white clouds while vultures and crows gather over the silent battlefield awaiting the coming slaughter.
Statues of gods tremble and appear to sweat blood while animals cry and meteors streak across a dust-choked sky above the trembling earth.
